name: @ai-ecoverse/slicc-browsers
description: SLICC's shared browser catalog, JSON schemas and discovery conformance corpus

scripts.lint: slicc-lint && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go mod tidy -diff && go vet ./... && GOOS=darwin go vet ./... && GOOS=windows go vet ./... && golangci-lint run && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo check --target wasm32-wasip1 --no-default-features && cargo check --target wasm32-wasip1 --features serde && cargo check --target wasm32-wasip1 --all-features

scripts.test:unit: mkdir -p coverage/unit && node --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/unit/lcov.info test/unit/*.test.mjs && go test -race -cover ./...
scripts.build: go build ./... && cargo build --all-features && cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 --all-features && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.test:unit:redirect: mkdir -p coverage/unit && node --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-coverage-include=redirect-secret.mjs --test-coverage-include=redirect-fragments.mjs --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/unit/redirect.lcov test/unit/guard-redirect-*.test.mjs && slicc-diff-cover coverage/unit/redirect.lcov
scripts.test:unit:guard: mkdir -p coverage/unit && node --experimental-vm-modules --no-warnings --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-coverage-include=guard-runner.mjs --test-coverage-include=guard-driver.mjs --test-coverage-include=fixture-server.mjs --test-coverage-include=fixture-client.mjs --test-coverage-include=observer-target.mjs --test-coverage-include=frame-read.mjs --test-coverage-include=bfcache-restore.mjs --test-coverage-include=protected-error-page.mjs --test-coverage-include=unparseable-url.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/browser-runner.mjs --test-coverage-include=scripts/validate.mjs --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/unit/guard.lcov test/unit/guard-*.test.mjs && slicc-diff-cover coverage/unit/guard.lcov
